holder-quote: The problem was—and here the Gnoll’s face fell—she only knew two spells.
She’d tried using it on the faerie flowers and made one bloom in moments, but just that had exhausted Mrsha.
effect-quote: Mrsha could make her grass really tall…but that was about it.

holder-quote: Mrsha felt sweat roll down her fur.
as soon as they realized how hard Mrsha was struggling, Elirr told her to free one Gnoll in each cage.
effect-quote: The shackles snapped, making several Raskghar look up.

holder-quote: [Wild Growth] is the spell I know
